record.field: List the models this key can read

List the Odoo models this user can read, optionally filtered by name. Call this first when you are unsure what a thing is called: Odoo model names are technical (res.partner for contacts, sale.order for sales orders).

List the fields of one model with their type, label and whether they are required or read-only. Use this before searching or writing so you use real field names rather than guesses. Fields marked masked will never return their value.

Search a model with an Odoo domain and return the fields you ask for. A domain is a list of [field, operator, value] triples, for example [["state","=","sale"],["amount_total",">",1000]]. Ask for the fewest fields that answer the question.
Read specific records by id. Use this after a search when you need more fields from a handful of records.
Group and count without reading rows
Group and aggregate without pulling every row: counts, sums and averages by one or more fields. Prefer this over searching thousands of records and adding them up yourself.
Create one record. Pass dry_run true first to see what would be created. This tool may require a human to approve the change before it happens.
Update fields on existing records, identified by id. Pass dry_run true first to see the current values alongside what you intend to set. This tool may require a human to approve the change.
Delete records by id. Deletion in Odoo is usually wrong: most records should be archived instead. Always dry_run first and tell the user exactly what would be removed.
